nodes.label: Move resource semantics

nodes.label: Open system formalisms

nodes.label: 58 mechanism atlas

nodes.label: 72 historical corpus records
nodes.rationale: Historical units mix organizations, products and protocol versions.

nodes.label: 101 protocol-version source units

nodes.label: Corpus unit normalization

nodes.label: Gamma requirement closure
nodes.rationale: Retain useful closure fragment with exact scope.

nodes.label: Delta idempotence defect

nodes.label: Sample versus exhaustive denominator

nodes.rationale: External provenance does not follow syntactic update form.

nodes.label: Four primitive basis claim

nodes.label: Provenance versus update syntax
nodes.rationale: Externality is an effect or assumption, not a scalar sort.

nodes.label: Syntactic generation benchmark
nodes.rationale: Term grammar matching is not semantic corpus completeness.

nodes.label: Hidden host-language power
nodes.rationale: Free folds, quantifiers, maps and nondeterminism hide actual expressiveness costs.

nodes.label: Temporal behavior distinction
nodes.rationale: Immediate and request/settlement systems can share arithmetic syntax but differ in traces.

nodes.label: Semantic corpus completeness
nodes.rationale: Requires behaviorally equivalent encoding relative to declared observations.

nodes.label: Domain-relative completeness
nodes.rationale: Declare the domain before making expressiveness claims.

nodes.label: Computational universality
nodes.rationale: Not a Moriarty goal; report distinguishes it from corpus completeness.

nodes.label: Semantic minimality
nodes.rationale: Constructor syntax does not establish financial or denotational minimality.

nodes.label: Port-confined conservation theorem
nodes.rationale: Conservation depends on explicit interface constraints and quantity-neutral foreign writes.

nodes.label: Global n-ary bindings
nodes.rationale: Binding-set associativity is narrower than behavioral composition.

nodes.label: Extremal prefix grammar separation
nodes.rationale: Non-definability is limited to the named selector-and-conjunction grammar.

nodes.label: Constructor independence theorem
nodes.rationale: usesX constructor absence proves a syntactic property only.

nodes.label: Keyword certificate defect
nodes.rationale: Keyword PASS does not recompute signatures or semantic judgments.

nodes.label: Corpus residues
nodes.rationale: Counterexamples and omitted behavior are retained as first-class empirical data.

nodes.label: Product-version-deployment identity
nodes.rationale: Organizations are containers; classification uses concrete product/version/deployment.

nodes.label: Economic function facet
nodes.rationale: Separate financial purpose from mechanism.

nodes.label: Instrument and claim facet
nodes.rationale: Distinguish tokens, debt, vault shares, contingent and legal claims.

nodes.label: Mechanism facet
nodes.rationale: AMM, CLOB, auction, liquidation and allocation are implementation mechanisms.

nodes.label: Execution and settlement facet
nodes.rationale: Capture chain/runtime, atomicity and async settlement differences.

nodes.label: Dependency control and trust facet
nodes.rationale: Expose custodians, oracles, sequencers, issuers, and legal obligors.

nodes.label: Dependency graph relationships
nodes.rationale: Record depends_on, issues, observes, settles_on, controlled_by and related edges.

nodes.label: Issuer fund custodian claim chain
nodes.rationale: RWA label alone cannot represent issuer, assets and custody relationships.

nodes.label: First-pass taxonomy crosswalk
nodes.rationale: Proposed recoding is not independently double-annotated ground truth.

nodes.label: Independent annotation and disagreement rules
nodes.rationale: Each disagreement needs an explicit reusable rule.

nodes.label: Twelve diverse holdouts
nodes.rationale: Freeze kernel then test conceptual diversity across execution environments.

nodes.label: Typed component interface
nodes.rationale: Typed ports delimit permitted connections.

nodes.label: Initialization predicate
nodes.rationale: Initialization is part of component semantics.

nodes.label: Labeled transition relation
nodes.rationale: Transition records actor, event, input, effects and obligations.

nodes.label: Declared observation map
nodes.rationale: Equivalence and fidelity require explicit observable behavior.

nodes.label: Read and write footprints
nodes.rationale: Footprints support frame and interference reasoning.

nodes.label: Effect summary
nodes.rationale: Protected/accounting operations remain visible to the verifier.

nodes.label: Component guarantee
nodes.rationale: Guarantees are conditional on declared assumptions.

nodes.label: Nominal financial identities
nodes.rationale: Party, Asset, Domain, Time, Claim, Capability and Message identities must not collapse to undifferentiated integers.

nodes.label: Dimensioned quantities
nodes.rationale: Asset quantities and valuations are not interchangeable integers.

nodes.label: Exact typed arithmetic
nodes.rationale: Financial operations need explicit implementation arithmetic semantics.

nodes.label: Kernel complexity cost model
nodes.rationale: Measure syntax, definitions, TCB, proof burden, annotations and escape-hatch power.

nodes.label: Sequential composition
nodes.rationale: Successor inputs must preserve predecessor output and obligation contracts.

nodes.label: Disjoint parallel composition
nodes.rationale: Private state remains disjoint while execution interleaves.

nodes.label: Shared-state interleaving
nodes.rationale: Rely/guarantee contracts control shared-cell interference.

nodes.label: Atomic synchronization
nodes.rationale: Named transitions participate in one atomic event.

nodes.label: Asynchronous cross-domain composition
nodes.rationale: Send/receive lifecycle and finality assumptions cannot be replaced by equal-state wiring.

nodes.label: Message lifecycle
nodes.rationale: Explicit created, observed, finalized, executable, executed and exceptional states.

nodes.label: Liability and obligation record
nodes.rationale: Preserve identity, debtor, creditor, asset/payoff, due, condition and status.

nodes.label: Token accounting versus economic accounting
nodes.rationale: Supply conservation does not imply solvency, liquidity or accessible backing.

nodes.label: Finite-description target class
nodes.rationale: Finite program description alone does not ensure bounded execution or finite state.

nodes.label: Unbounded numeric domains proposal
nodes.rationale: This report proposal conflicts with Moriarty explicit finite bounded numeric profile.

nodes.label: Trace equivalence and weak bisimulation
nodes.rationale: Compare observations while hiding declared internal events.

nodes.label: Type preservation
nodes.rationale: Transitions preserve typed state and financial identities.

nodes.label: Asset-indexed accounting theorem
nodes.rationale: Balance deltas equal authorized issuance, retirement and explicit external flows.

nodes.label: Authority safety theorem
nodes.rationale: Protected effects require valid capabilities; composition cannot manufacture authority.

nodes.label: Frame and noninterference theorem
nodes.rationale: Disjoint writes preserve another component state predicates.

nodes.label: Assume-guarantee composition theorem
nodes.rationale: Partner guarantees discharge internal assumptions while external assumptions remain.

nodes.label: Behavioral structural associativity
nodes.rationale: Lift global binding associativity into behavior up to interface/state renaming.

nodes.label: Obligation preservation theorem
nodes.rationale: Claims may change status or owner but cannot silently disappear.

nodes.label: Conservative extension theorem
nodes.rationale: Fresh unused library/state/effect types do not change old observable traces.

nodes.label: Conditional solvency and liveness
nodes.rationale: Valuation, liquidity, legal truth and asynchronous fairness remain separate conditional models.

nodes.label: Authorized attestation versus truth
nodes.rationale: A valid signature or ZK computation does not prove real-world inputs.

nodes.label: Uniswap concentrated liquidity regression
nodes.rationale: Preserve Q64.96, directional rounding, fees, bounded tick processing and liquidity transitions.

nodes.label: Curve iterative invariant regression
nodes.rationale: Specify integer Newton bounds, iteration/failure behavior and source refinement.

nodes.label: Liquity ordered redemption regression
nodes.rationale: Model ordered state, branch routing and protocol-specific traversal.

nodes.label: Morpho bad debt regression
nodes.rationale: Represent debt obligations and share-price loss allocation, not just token quantities.

nodes.label: Balancer shared transient accounting regression
nodes.rationale: Hooks share explicit vault accounting; atomic completion settles transient deltas.

nodes.label: Cross-domain settlement regression
nodes.rationale: Source finality, message replay protection and destination actions are explicit.

nodes.label: Margin and funding regression
nodes.rationale: Contingent P&L, borrow balances, funding, liquidation and bankruptcy resources differ from spendable assets.

nodes.label: Conditional insurance claim regression
nodes.rationale: Authorized adjudication leaves real-world proof-of-loss semantics external.

nodes.label: Typed module and transition IR
nodes.rationale: Explicit types, state, interfaces, assumptions, invariants, libraries, observations and source maps.

nodes.label: Checkable certificate judgments
nodes.rationale: Certificate tags are inputs; checker recomputes IR/proof judgments.

nodes.label: Conditional linear checking complexity
nodes.rationale: AST traversal bound does not imply linear proof generation or arithmetic solving.

nodes.label: Model-to-contract fidelity
nodes.rationale: Compare full balances, shares, debt, positions, fees, ordering, statuses, messages and claims.

nodes.label: Differential execution
nodes.rationale: Compare generated sequences against independently grounded reference implementation.

nodes.label: Mutation testing
nodes.rationale: Reject changes to rounding, authority, order, bad debt, settlement delay and provenance.

nodes.label: Refinement proof
nodes.rationale: Show concrete transitions simulate IR transitions for selected finite core domains.

nodes.label: Investigation reproduction scope
nodes.rationale: Report did not rebuild Lean or Quint, and sampled Python/Node outputs are not exhaustive proof.

nodes.label: Evidence class separation
nodes.rationale: Store proof, bounded execution and measurement distinctly.

nodes.label: Benchmark freeze and normalization stage
nodes.rationale: Freeze semantics and normalized benchmark, then encode transfer, vault and oracle credit.

nodes.label: Kernel proofs and adversarial libraries stage
nodes.rationale: Mechanize conditional theorems and port eight difficult regression classes.

nodes.label: Frozen-kernel generalization stage
nodes.rationale: Use holdouts to measure new kernel concepts separately from library additions.

nodes.label: Deferred optional proof-carrying integration proposal
nodes.rationale: Conflicts with Moriarty mandatory PCD design constraint; retain distinction among proof classes without deferring core acceptance architecture.

nodes.label: Moriarty Compact ZKIR evidence disclaimer
nodes.rationale: Report did not verify these interfaces; adapter capabilities need independent source evidence.

nodes.label: Kernel versus library extension criterion
nodes.rationale: New financial library does not itself refute the kernel; new semantic concepts require metatheory revision.

nodes.label: Move resource semantics

nodes.label: 58 mechanism atlas
nodes.rationale: Retain empirical mechanisms without treating their count as a semantic basis.

nodes.rationale: Historical units mix organizations, products and protocol versions.

nodes.label: 101 protocol-version source units
nodes.rationale: Atlas source universe differs from the later 72 records.

nodes.label: Gamma requirement closure
nodes.rationale: Retain useful closure fragment with exact scope.

nodes.label: Delta idempotence defect

nodes.label: Lattice versus set-operation closure
nodes.rationale: Failure of union/intersection closure alone does not prove the induced poset is not a lattice.

nodes.label: Sample versus exhaustive denominator
nodes.rationale: Report distinguishes a corpus sample from the full definite lattice.

nodes.label: Withdrawn Q Sigma partition
nodes.rationale: External provenance does not follow syntactic update form.

nodes.label: Four primitive basis claim
nodes.rationale: Report rejects reliance on Led/Prop/Cmp/Post as a semantic minimal basis.

nodes.label: Provenance versus update syntax
nodes.rationale: Externality is an effect or assumption, not a scalar sort.

nodes.label: Syntactic generation benchmark
nodes.rationale: Term grammar matching is not semantic corpus completeness.

nodes.label: Hidden host-language power
nodes.rationale: Free folds, quantifiers, maps and nondeterminism hide actual expressiveness costs.

nodes.label: Temporal behavior distinction
nodes.rationale: Immediate and request/settlement systems can share arithmetic syntax but differ in traces.

nodes.label: Semantic corpus completeness
nodes.rationale: Requires behaviorally equivalent encoding relative to declared observations.

nodes.label: Domain-relative completeness
nodes.rationale: Declare the domain before making expressiveness claims.

nodes.label: Computational universality
nodes.rationale: Not a Moriarty goal; report distinguishes it from corpus completeness.

nodes.label: Semantic minimality
nodes.rationale: Constructor syntax does not establish financial or denotational minimality.

nodes.label: Port-confined conservation theorem
nodes.rationale: Conservation depends on explicit interface constraints and quantity-neutral foreign writes.

nodes.label: Global n-ary bindings
nodes.rationale: Binding-set associativity is narrower than behavioral composition.

nodes.label: Extremal prefix grammar separation
nodes.rationale: Non-definability is limited to the named selector-and-conjunction grammar.

nodes.label: Constructor independence theorem
nodes.rationale: usesX constructor absence proves a syntactic property only.

nodes.label: Keyword certificate defect
nodes.rationale: Keyword PASS does not recompute signatures or semantic judgments.

nodes.label: Corpus residues
nodes.rationale: Counterexamples and omitted behavior are retained as first-class empirical data.

nodes.label: Product-version-deployment identity
nodes.rationale: Organizations are containers; classification uses concrete product/version/deployment.

nodes.label: Economic function facet
nodes.rationale: Separate financial purpose from mechanism.

nodes.label: Instrument and claim facet
nodes.rationale: Distinguish tokens, debt, vault shares, contingent and legal claims.

nodes.label: Mechanism facet
nodes.rationale: AMM, CLOB, auction, liquidation and allocation are implementation mechanisms.

nodes.label: Execution and settlement facet
nodes.rationale: Capture chain/runtime, atomicity and async settlement differences.

nodes.label: Dependency control and trust facet
nodes.rationale: Expose custodians, oracles, sequencers, issuers, and legal obligors.

nodes.label: Dependency graph relationships
nodes.rationale: Record depends_on, issues, observes, settles_on, controlled_by and related edges.

nodes.label: Issuer fund custodian claim chain
nodes.rationale: RWA label alone cannot represent issuer, assets and custody relationships.

nodes.label: First-pass taxonomy crosswalk
nodes.rationale: Proposed recoding is not independently double-annotated ground truth.

nodes.label: Independent annotation and disagreement rules
nodes.rationale: Each disagreement needs an explicit reusable rule.

nodes.label: Twelve diverse holdouts
nodes.rationale: Freeze kernel then test conceptual diversity across execution environments.

nodes.label: Typed component interface
nodes.rationale: Typed ports delimit permitted connections.

nodes.label: Initialization predicate
nodes.rationale: Initialization is part of component semantics.

nodes.label: Labeled transition relation
nodes.rationale: Transition records actor, event, input, effects and obligations.

nodes.label: Declared observation map
nodes.rationale: Equivalence and fidelity require explicit observable behavior.

nodes.label: Read and write footprints
nodes.rationale: Footprints support frame and interference reasoning.

nodes.label: Effect summary
nodes.rationale: Protected/accounting operations remain visible to the verifier.

nodes.label: Component guarantee
nodes.rationale: Guarantees are conditional on declared assumptions.

nodes.label: Nominal financial identities
nodes.rationale: Party, Asset, Domain, Time, Claim, Capability and Message identities must not collapse to undifferentiated integers.

nodes.label: Dimensioned quantities
nodes.rationale: Asset quantities and valuations are not interchangeable integers.

nodes.label: Exact typed arithmetic
nodes.rationale: Financial operations need explicit implementation arithmetic semantics.

nodes.label: Kernel complexity cost model
nodes.rationale: Measure syntax, definitions, TCB, proof burden, annotations and escape-hatch power.

nodes.label: Sequential composition
nodes.rationale: Successor inputs must preserve predecessor output and obligation contracts.

nodes.label: Disjoint parallel composition
nodes.rationale: Private state remains disjoint while execution interleaves.

nodes.label: Shared-state interleaving
nodes.rationale: Rely/guarantee contracts control shared-cell interference.

nodes.label: Atomic synchronization
nodes.rationale: Named transitions participate in one atomic event.

nodes.label: Asynchronous cross-domain composition
nodes.rationale: Send/receive lifecycle and finality assumptions cannot be replaced by equal-state wiring.

nodes.label: Message lifecycle
nodes.rationale: Explicit created, observed, finalized, executable, executed and exceptional states.

nodes.label: Liability and obligation record
nodes.rationale: Preserve identity, debtor, creditor, asset/payoff, due, condition and status.

nodes.label: Token accounting versus economic accounting
nodes.rationale: Supply conservation does not imply solvency, liquidity or accessible backing.

nodes.label: Finite-description target class
nodes.rationale: Finite program description alone does not ensure bounded execution or finite state.

nodes.label: Unbounded numeric domains proposal
nodes.rationale: This report proposal conflicts with Moriarty explicit finite bounded numeric profile.

nodes.label: Trace equivalence and weak bisimulation
nodes.rationale: Compare observations while hiding declared internal events.

nodes.label: Type preservation
nodes.rationale: Transitions preserve typed state and financial identities.

nodes.label: Asset-indexed accounting theorem
nodes.rationale: Balance deltas equal authorized issuance, retirement and explicit external flows.

nodes.label: Authority safety theorem
nodes.rationale: Protected effects require valid capabilities; composition cannot manufacture authority.

nodes.label: Frame and noninterference theorem
nodes.rationale: Disjoint writes preserve another component state predicates.

nodes.label: Assume-guarantee composition theorem
nodes.rationale: Partner guarantees discharge internal assumptions while external assumptions remain.

nodes.label: Behavioral structural associativity
nodes.rationale: Lift global binding associativity into behavior up to interface/state renaming.

nodes.label: Obligation preservation theorem
nodes.rationale: Claims may change status or owner but cannot silently disappear.

nodes.label: Conservative extension theorem
nodes.rationale: Fresh unused library/state/effect types do not change old observable traces.

nodes.label: Conditional solvency and liveness
nodes.rationale: Valuation, liquidity, legal truth and asynchronous fairness remain separate conditional models.

nodes.label: Authorized attestation versus truth
nodes.rationale: A valid signature or ZK computation does not prove real-world inputs.

nodes.label: Uniswap concentrated liquidity regression
nodes.rationale: Preserve Q64.96, directional rounding, fees, bounded tick processing and liquidity transitions.

nodes.label: Curve iterative invariant regression
nodes.rationale: Specify integer Newton bounds, iteration/failure behavior and source refinement.

nodes.label: Liquity ordered redemption regression
nodes.rationale: Model ordered state, branch routing and protocol-specific traversal.

nodes.label: Morpho bad debt regression
nodes.rationale: Represent debt obligations and share-price loss allocation, not just token quantities.

nodes.label: Balancer shared transient accounting regression
nodes.rationale: Hooks share explicit vault accounting; atomic completion settles transient deltas.

nodes.label: Cross-domain settlement regression
nodes.rationale: Source finality, message replay protection and destination actions are explicit.

nodes.label: Margin and funding regression
nodes.rationale: Contingent P&L, borrow balances, funding, liquidation and bankruptcy resources differ from spendable assets.

nodes.label: Conditional insurance claim regression
nodes.rationale: Authorized adjudication leaves real-world proof-of-loss semantics external.

nodes.label: Typed module and transition IR
nodes.rationale: Explicit types, state, interfaces, assumptions, invariants, libraries, observations and source maps.

nodes.label: Checkable certificate judgments
nodes.rationale: Certificate tags are inputs; checker recomputes IR/proof judgments.

nodes.label: Conditional linear checking complexity
nodes.rationale: AST traversal bound does not imply linear proof generation or arithmetic solving.

nodes.label: Model-to-contract fidelity
nodes.rationale: Compare full balances, shares, debt, positions, fees, ordering, statuses, messages and claims.

nodes.label: Differential execution
nodes.rationale: Compare generated sequences against independently grounded reference implementation.

nodes.label: Mutation testing
nodes.rationale: Reject changes to rounding, authority, order, bad debt, settlement delay and provenance.

nodes.label: Refinement proof
nodes.rationale: Show concrete transitions simulate IR transitions for selected finite core domains.

nodes.label: Investigation reproduction scope
nodes.rationale: Report did not rebuild Lean or Quint, and sampled Python/Node outputs are not exhaustive proof.

nodes.label: Evidence class separation
nodes.rationale: Store proof, bounded execution and measurement distinctly.

nodes.label: Benchmark freeze and normalization stage
nodes.rationale: Freeze semantics and normalized benchmark, then encode transfer, vault and oracle credit.

nodes.label: Kernel proofs and adversarial libraries stage
nodes.rationale: Mechanize conditional theorems and port eight difficult regression classes.

nodes.label: Frozen-kernel generalization stage
nodes.rationale: Use holdouts to measure new kernel concepts separately from library additions.

nodes.label: Deferred optional proof-carrying integration proposal
nodes.rationale: Conflicts with Moriarty mandatory PCD design constraint; retain distinction among proof classes without deferring core acceptance architecture.

nodes.label: Moriarty Compact ZKIR evidence disclaimer
nodes.rationale: Report did not verify these interfaces; adapter capabilities need independent source evidence.

nodes.label: Kernel versus library extension criterion
nodes.rationale: New financial library does not itself refute the kernel; new semantic concepts require metatheory revision.

nodes.label: Typed open transition kernel

nodes.label: Runtime adapters
nodes.rationale: Keep chain enforcement separate from source semantics.

nodes.label: Environment assumptions
nodes.rationale: External facts are inputs with assumptions, not theorems of token accounting.

nodes.label: ACTUS
nodes.rationale: Contract algorithms and obligations are separate from behavioral risk assumptions.

nodes.label: FINOS CDM
nodes.rationale: Product, trade, lifecycle event and state transition layers are separate.

nodes.label: Marlowe
nodes.rationale: Small contract semantics and blockchain execution interface are separate.

nodes.label: Move resource semantics
nodes.rationale: Ownership, non-copyability and capabilities are structural.

nodes.label: Open system formalisms
nodes.rationale: Interfaces and wiring are distinct from internal dynamics.

nodes.label: 58 mechanism atlas
nodes.rationale: Retain empirical mechanisms without treating their count as a semantic basis.

nodes.label: 72 historical corpus records
nodes.rationale: Historical units mix organizations, products and protocol versions.

nodes.label: 101 protocol-version source units
nodes.rationale: Atlas source universe differs from the later 72 records.

nodes.label: Corpus unit normalization
nodes.rationale: Normalize product-version-deployment while retaining historical record identities.

nodes.label: Gamma requirement closure
nodes.rationale: Retain useful closure fragment with exact scope.

nodes.label: Delta idempotence defect
nodes.rationale: Report identifies documentation still calling a non-idempotent operator a kernel.

nodes.label: Lattice versus set-operation closure
nodes.rationale: Failure of union/intersection closure alone does not prove the induced poset is not a lattice.

nodes.label: Sample versus exhaustive denominator
nodes.rationale: Report distinguishes a corpus sample from the full definite lattice.

nodes.label: Withdrawn Q Sigma partition
nodes.rationale: External provenance does not follow syntactic update form.

nodes.label: Four primitive basis claim
nodes.rationale: Report rejects reliance on Led/Prop/Cmp/Post as a semantic minimal basis.

nodes.label: Provenance versus update syntax
nodes.rationale: Externality is an effect or assumption, not a scalar sort.

nodes.label: Syntactic generation benchmark
nodes.rationale: Term grammar matching is not semantic corpus completeness.

nodes.label: Hidden host-language power
nodes.rationale: Free folds, quantifiers, maps and nondeterminism hide actual expressiveness costs.

nodes.label: Temporal behavior distinction
nodes.rationale: Immediate and request/settlement systems can share arithmetic syntax but differ in traces.

nodes.label: Semantic corpus completeness
nodes.rationale: Requires behaviorally equivalent encoding relative to declared observations.

nodes.label: Domain-relative completeness
nodes.rationale: Declare the domain before making expressiveness claims.

nodes.label: Computational universality
nodes.rationale: Not a Moriarty goal; report distinguishes it from corpus completeness.

nodes.label: Semantic minimality
nodes.rationale: Constructor syntax does not establish financial or denotational minimality.

nodes.label: Port-confined conservation theorem
nodes.rationale: Conservation depends on explicit interface constraints and quantity-neutral foreign writes.

nodes.label: Global n-ary bindings
nodes.rationale: Binding-set associativity is narrower than behavioral composition.

nodes.label: Extremal prefix grammar separation
nodes.rationale: Non-definability is limited to the named selector-and-conjunction grammar.

nodes.label: Constructor independence theorem
nodes.rationale: usesX constructor absence proves a syntactic property only.

nodes.label: Keyword certificate defect
nodes.rationale: Keyword PASS does not recompute signatures or semantic judgments.

nodes.label: Corpus residues
nodes.rationale: Counterexamples and omitted behavior are retained as first-class empirical data.

nodes.label: Product-version-deployment identity
nodes.rationale: Organizations are containers; classification uses concrete product/version/deployment.

nodes.label: Economic function facet
nodes.rationale: Separate financial purpose from mechanism.

nodes.label: Instrument and claim facet
nodes.rationale: Distinguish tokens, debt, vault shares, contingent and legal claims.

nodes.label: Mechanism facet
nodes.rationale: AMM, CLOB, auction, liquidation and allocation are implementation mechanisms.

nodes.label: Execution and settlement facet
nodes.rationale: Capture chain/runtime, atomicity and async settlement differences.

nodes.label: Dependency control and trust facet
nodes.rationale: Expose custodians, oracles, sequencers, issuers, and legal obligors.

nodes.label: Dependency graph relationships
nodes.rationale: Record depends_on, issues, observes, settles_on, controlled_by and related edges.

nodes.label: Issuer fund custodian claim chain
nodes.rationale: RWA label alone cannot represent issuer, assets and custody relationships.

nodes.label: First-pass taxonomy crosswalk
nodes.rationale: Proposed recoding is not independently double-annotated ground truth.

nodes.label: Independent annotation and disagreement rules
nodes.rationale: Each disagreement needs an explicit reusable rule.

nodes.label: Twelve diverse holdouts
nodes.rationale: Freeze kernel then test conceptual diversity across execution environments.

nodes.label: Typed component interface
nodes.rationale: Typed ports delimit permitted connections.

nodes.label: Initialization predicate
nodes.rationale: Initialization is part of component semantics.

nodes.label: Labeled transition relation
nodes.rationale: Transition records actor, event, input, effects and obligations.

nodes.label: Declared observation map
nodes.rationale: Equivalence and fidelity require explicit observable behavior.

nodes.label: Read and write footprints
nodes.rationale: Footprints support frame and interference reasoning.

nodes.label: Effect summary
nodes.rationale: Protected/accounting operations remain visible to the verifier.

nodes.label: Component guarantee
nodes.rationale: Guarantees are conditional on declared assumptions.

nodes.label: Nominal financial identities
nodes.rationale: Party, Asset, Domain, Time, Claim, Capability and Message identities must not collapse to undifferentiated integers.

nodes.label: Dimensioned quantities
nodes.rationale: Asset quantities and valuations are not interchangeable integers.

nodes.label: Exact typed arithmetic
nodes.rationale: Financial operations need explicit implementation arithmetic semantics.

nodes.label: Kernel complexity cost model
nodes.rationale: Measure syntax, definitions, TCB, proof burden, annotations and escape-hatch power.

nodes.label: Sequential composition
nodes.rationale: Successor inputs must preserve predecessor output and obligation contracts.

nodes.label: Disjoint parallel composition
nodes.rationale: Private state remains disjoint while execution interleaves.

nodes.label: Shared-state interleaving
nodes.rationale: Rely/guarantee contracts control shared-cell interference.

nodes.label: Atomic synchronization
nodes.rationale: Named transitions participate in one atomic event.

nodes.label: Asynchronous cross-domain composition
nodes.rationale: Send/receive lifecycle and finality assumptions cannot be replaced by equal-state wiring.

nodes.label: Message lifecycle
nodes.rationale: Explicit created, observed, finalized, executable, executed and exceptional states.

nodes.label: Liability and obligation record
nodes.rationale: Preserve identity, debtor, creditor, asset/payoff, due, condition and status.

nodes.label: Token accounting versus economic accounting
nodes.rationale: Supply conservation does not imply solvency, liquidity or accessible backing.

nodes.label: Finite-description target class
nodes.rationale: Finite program description alone does not ensure bounded execution or finite state.

nodes.label: Unbounded numeric domains proposal
nodes.rationale: This report proposal conflicts with Moriarty explicit finite bounded numeric profile.

nodes.label: Trace equivalence and weak bisimulation
nodes.rationale: Compare observations while hiding declared internal events.

nodes.label: Type preservation
nodes.rationale: Transitions preserve typed state and financial identities.

nodes.label: Asset-indexed accounting theorem
nodes.rationale: Balance deltas equal authorized issuance, retirement and explicit external flows.

nodes.label: Authority safety theorem
nodes.rationale: Protected effects require valid capabilities; composition cannot manufacture authority.

nodes.label: Frame and noninterference theorem
nodes.rationale: Disjoint writes preserve another component state predicates.

nodes.label: Assume-guarantee composition theorem
nodes.rationale: Partner guarantees discharge internal assumptions while external assumptions remain.

nodes.label: Behavioral structural associativity
nodes.rationale: Lift global binding associativity into behavior up to interface/state renaming.

nodes.label: Obligation preservation theorem
nodes.rationale: Claims may change status or owner but cannot silently disappear.

nodes.label: Conservative extension theorem
nodes.rationale: Fresh unused library/state/effect types do not change old observable traces.

nodes.label: Conditional solvency and liveness
nodes.rationale: Valuation, liquidity, legal truth and asynchronous fairness remain separate conditional models.

nodes.label: Authorized attestation versus truth
nodes.rationale: A valid signature or ZK computation does not prove real-world inputs.

nodes.label: Uniswap concentrated liquidity regression
nodes.rationale: Preserve Q64.96, directional rounding, fees, bounded tick processing and liquidity transitions.

nodes.label: Curve iterative invariant regression
nodes.rationale: Specify integer Newton bounds, iteration/failure behavior and source refinement.

nodes.label: Liquity ordered redemption regression
nodes.rationale: Model ordered state, branch routing and protocol-specific traversal.

nodes.label: Morpho bad debt regression
nodes.rationale: Represent debt obligations and share-price loss allocation, not just token quantities.

nodes.label: Balancer shared transient accounting regression
nodes.rationale: Hooks share explicit vault accounting; atomic completion settles transient deltas.

nodes.label: Cross-domain settlement regression
nodes.rationale: Source finality, message replay protection and destination actions are explicit.

nodes.label: Margin and funding regression
nodes.rationale: Contingent P&L, borrow balances, funding, liquidation and bankruptcy resources differ from spendable assets.

nodes.label: Conditional insurance claim regression
nodes.rationale: Authorized adjudication leaves real-world proof-of-loss semantics external.

nodes.label: Typed module and transition IR
nodes.rationale: Explicit types, state, interfaces, assumptions, invariants, libraries, observations and source maps.

nodes.label: Checkable certificate judgments
nodes.rationale: Certificate tags are inputs; checker recomputes IR/proof judgments.

nodes.label: Conditional linear checking complexity
nodes.rationale: AST traversal bound does not imply linear proof generation or arithmetic solving.

nodes.label: Model-to-contract fidelity
nodes.rationale: Compare full balances, shares, debt, positions, fees, ordering, statuses, messages and claims.

nodes.label: Differential execution
nodes.rationale: Compare generated sequences against independently grounded reference implementation.

nodes.label: Mutation testing
nodes.rationale: Reject changes to rounding, authority, order, bad debt, settlement delay and provenance.

nodes.label: Refinement proof
nodes.rationale: Show concrete transitions simulate IR transitions for selected finite core domains.

nodes.label: Investigation reproduction scope
nodes.rationale: Report did not rebuild Lean or Quint, and sampled Python/Node outputs are not exhaustive proof.

nodes.label: Evidence class separation
nodes.rationale: Store proof, bounded execution and measurement distinctly.

nodes.label: Benchmark freeze and normalization stage
nodes.rationale: Freeze semantics and normalized benchmark, then encode transfer, vault and oracle credit.

nodes.label: Kernel proofs and adversarial libraries stage
nodes.rationale: Mechanize conditional theorems and port eight difficult regression classes.

nodes.label: Frozen-kernel generalization stage
nodes.rationale: Use holdouts to measure new kernel concepts separately from library additions.

nodes.label: Deferred optional proof-carrying integration proposal
nodes.rationale: Conflicts with Moriarty mandatory PCD design constraint; retain distinction among proof classes without deferring core acceptance architecture.

nodes.label: Moriarty Compact ZKIR evidence disclaimer
nodes.rationale: Report did not verify these interfaces; adapter capabilities need independent source evidence.

nodes.label: Kernel versus library extension criterion
nodes.rationale: New financial library does not itself refute the kernel; new semantic concepts require metatheory revision.
